auditor_jenn: Hi team - auditor here. For the SOC 2 fieldwork we need a consolidated package: 1) RBAC change history for the week of 2026-03-08..2026-03-14 (who/what/why), 2) KMS key rotation proof (rotation event + unwrap/wrap logs + policy diff), 3) vuln triage timeline for CVE-2026-0101 from detection->mitigation, and 4) incident response evidence (bridge calls, sign-in logs, postmortem draft). Also requesting a short Zoom to walk through artifacts.
sarah-sec: hey @auditor_jenn - we can put that together. I'll assemble an artifacts bundle and redact PII where needed. ETA end of day today. Do you need raw logs or redacted exports?
auditor_jenn: raw preferred, redacted ok for user identifiers. We can sign a limited-scope NDA if you want to avoid sharing raw creds.
mike-oncall: FYI I have a script to export everything: `./scripts/export_audit_bundle.sh --range 2026-03-08:2026-03-14 --include=kms,rbac,vuln,incident --format=tar.gz` It uploads to s3://redwood-audit-uploads/auditor_jenn/1747210001-bundle.tar.gz and creates a 72h presigned URL.
rob-eng: for RBAC change logs we'll include CloudTrail entries + internal authz-service audit log. Example event: ```json
{"user":"maya","action":"role.bind","resource":"proj/serve","ts":"2026-03-11T10:12:33Z","request_id":"req-9a8b"}
``` We'll also produce CSV exports with context (PR link, deploy link).
sarah-sec: KMS rotation note: CMK `redwood-prod-01` rotated 2026-03-12 02:03Z. We will include KMS rotation event, key policy revision diff, and KMS envelope unwrap entries showing which principals performed decrypt/unwrapping. Note: key material never leaves HSM.
auditor_jenn: good. please include the mapping of each artifact to the SOC 2/ISO control IDs (e.g., CC6, A.10.1.1 equivalents). A control-map csv would be ideal.
rob-eng: on vuln triage: detected by automated scanner 2026-03-09 04:22Z, triaged same day, mitigation PR #341 merged 2026-03-10, canary deploy 2026-03-11, full rollout 2026-03-11 18:00Z. No rollback. Postmortem PR #342 (draft) will be included.
mike-oncall: I can do a 30-min Zoom walkthrough tomorrow 09:00 UTC to demo the bundle and the incident playbook. @auditor_jenn works? :thumbsup:
auditor_jenn: That time works. Please post the presigned link here once upload completes, and include a short README (checksums, included files, and any redaction notes). Thanks!
